title: Display nested task cards in board views
userStory: As a developer, I want to see sub-stories nested under their parent features so that I can understand the hierarchy.
acceptanceCriteria: Kanban view: parent cards expandable to show children inline
Kanban view: option to show children as separate cards (flat mode)
List view: expandable rows with indented children
Parent card shows progress: '5/12 stories complete'
Filter option: show features only, show stories only, show all
Visual connector lines in kanban between parent and children (optional)
